summary: fruit_zipnerf: ZipNeRF base model instead of Nerfacto for FruitNeRF.

notes: FruitNeRF's binary semantic head on a ZipNeRF backbone, registered as the nerfstudio method 'fruit_zipnerf'.
pip-installed (not repo-sourced), so --fruit-nerf-repo does not point at it; the import is what matters.
Depends on /workspace/Desktop/Repos/zipnerf-pytorch for the backbone and on Nerfstudio_Patch for the frozen contract.
Emits accumulation, depth, per-sample density in [..., S, 1] and semantics -- the contract InvNeRF-Seg's cloud generator consumes.
RESUME.md in the repo root is the entry point; CAMP_DELTAS.md audits the camp_zipnerf port.
